name: com.unity.multiplayer.tools
description: Adds a suite of tools that improve workflows for multiplayer development

samples.description:
Samples showcasing the different ways of building custom network simulator scenarios.

Note: In order to use these Samples, make sure you have Netcode for GameObjects (com.unity.netcode.gameobjects) 1.1.0 or later and Unity Transport (com.unity.transport) 2.0.0 or later. For more info, please check the Network Simulator documentation: https://docs-multiplayer.unity3d.com/tools/current/tools-network-simulator

_upm.changelog:
### Fixed
- Network Object ownership icons in the Hierarchy Network Debug View now render in the new UI Toolkit Hierarchy window (Unity 6000.5+); previously they only appeared in the legacy IMGUI hierarchy.
- Fixed the NGO adapter never registering when the NetworkManager was instantiated before the tools package initialized (regression in 2.2.9).
